positions.statement: Silber says they were the only councilor who voted against proposing a new Rivergrove tax, which they say Rivergrove rejected in May.
positions.excerpt: I’m the only councilor who voted against pitching a new Rivergrove tax, and in May, Rivergrove rejected it decisively.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 48, printed C-47)

positions.statement: Silber says the city should spend on what residents need, get competitive bids before hiring, follow budget law and act on the recent audit's findings.
positions.excerpt: We should spend on what residents need, get competitive bids before hiring, start following budget law, and act on everything the recent audit found.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Voters' Pamphlet, Nov 3 2026 (PDF p. 48, printed C-47)
